citations.case: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.1.d.1.a (sepsis: assign the systemic infection code; A40.0 is the combination code for group A streptococcal sepsis, so no separate B95.0); Section I.C.1.d.4 (sepsis with a localized infection present on admission: the systemic infection code is sequenced first, the localized infection second); Section I.C.1.d.1.b (severe sepsis requires provider documentation of associated acute organ dysfunction; R65.2- is not assigned from vital signs or lactate alone)

coder_notes: Hypotension and elevated lactate without a provider statement of severe sepsis or organ dysfunction is a query opportunity, not a coding decision. Traps: Assigning R65.20/R65.21 (severe sepsis / septic shock) from the hypotension and lactate of 3.2 when the provider documented only sepsis without organ dysfunction; sequencing J36 as principal because the abscess was the surgical focus; using A41.9 or A40.9 plus B95.0 instead of the specific group A combination code
